title: Tianji Record, Page Eight
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji drew out the yellowed secret agreement from his embrace, the gaze of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly became profound—that document, which should have been a mere bargaining chip casually obtained three years ago, had now become the sole key to reaching his father.

text.content: The blood-colored afterglow slowly faded from Chen Nian's pupils. Her body trembled gently, as if she had just traversed a journey spanning life and death. Chen Ji caught her with one swift motion; his fingertips touched her icy wrist bones, and the taut string in his heart tightened yet another notch. "What did you see?" His voice was平静得近乎冷漠，only the hand supporting his sister pressed slightly harder, betraying a sliver of tension.

dialogue.content: "Seven hundred and ninety-nine... Brother, you will die." Chen Nian's voice arrived from a distant place, carrying a desolation unfitting for her age. "The Tianji Record is red, blood is red too, and those eyes... those eyes are laughing."

text.content: Those eyes are laughing. Chen Ji turned this sentence over in his mind three times, yet a faint smile surfaced on his face. "Of course it should laugh." He released Chen Nian and stood up, his gaze falling upon the churning dark clouds in the distance. "Because it thinks it has already won." The fragment of the Tianji Record in his embrace burned faintly hot, and that familiar scalding sensation reminded him—new power was stirring once more.

Mo Xiansheng's voice arrived at the perfect moment, carrying an uncommon gravity: "Boy, the scene your sister witnessed is the Tianji Record's本体's projection of the future." The remnant soul's shadow slowly materialized from the book pages; when its gaze fell upon Chen Nian, it carried an indescribable complexity. "It is also what the Heavenly Eye wishes you to see—it is warning you, and mocking you."

dialogue.content: "Warning and mocking?" Chen Ji softly repeated, the curve of his lips growing increasingly sardonic. "Since it wishes me to see this, it means it believes this path is impassable for me." He raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade. "Then I will walk it specifically to prove it wrong."

text.content: The words fell, and the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with heat. Chen Ji felt as if a branding iron had been pressed hard against his chest. A torrential stream of information flooded into his consciousness like a flood. Page Eight—the Tianji Record's Page Eight—was actually manifesting on its own at this moment. "Impossible!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul lost composure for the first time; the shadow quivered violently. "The manifestation of the Tianji Record requires consuming massive Heavenly Fate Value. In your current state, you cannot withstand—"

Chen Ji paid no heed to Mo Xiansheng's cry. His consciousness was seized by that stream of information, plunging into a chaotic Void. There, he witnessed a scene—a palace suspended above the Nine Heavens, its gates sealed tight, surrounded by countless layers of profound prohibitions. And within the deepest cage of that palace, a withered figure slowly lifted its head. It was a face bearing seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, save that the eyes had long lost their spark.

dialogue.content: "Father..." The word escaped Chen Ji's lips, and even he paused for a moment. How many years had it been since he called out that title? Thirteen years. Ever since the night the Chen Clan was annihilated, he had forged himself into a blade without emotion. But now, gazing upon those hollow eyes, a corner of his heart long buried deep within began to ache faintly.

text.content: The Tianji Record's Page Eight slowly unfurled before Chen Ji's eyes. Golden characters danced like living beings: Fate's Chosen Chen Tianming, not dead, imprisoned in the Tianji Palace core—Tianji Hall. To rescue this person, three items must be gathered: the Righteous Path token, Qingyun Token; the Demonic Path token, Youming Bead; and... Chen Ji's gaze froze on the final line, his pupils narrowing sharply. "Heavenly Fate Lock's Blood."

"Heavenly Fate Lock..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul murmured the words, his voice carrying a complexity Chen Ji had never heard before. "So that was it, so that was it. The Heavenly Eye has been setting the board from the very beginning. Your sister—her blood was always the crucial piece in this game." The remnant's shadow turned toward Chen Nian, and something resembling pity flickered in its gaze. "It is not using her; it is using her to threaten you."

dialogue.content: "Brother, I'm not afraid." Chen Nian suddenly spoke. Though she did not know exactly what the Tianji Record had revealed, she keenly sensed the heaviness permeating the air. Her hand gently gripped Chen Ji's sleeve. Her voice was soft yet remarkably firm. "As long as it saves Father, I am willing to do anything."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his sister, to those eyes so identical to his own. The icy string in his heart suddenly quivered. He reached out and gently ruffled her hair, the motion awkward yet carrying a clumsy tenderness. "Silly girl." He spoke softly. "Your blood is not meant for sacrifice—it is meant to open that door. And I will find a way that requires neither you risking your life nor Father remaining imprisoned."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji paused before the Tianji Palace gates, contemplating his next strategic moves. The Righteous Path token, the Qingyun Token, was in the hands of Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect; the Demonic Path token, the Youming Bead, was controlled by the Demonic Saintess Ye Qing—and he happened to hold a special trump card.

choices.text: Strategic Layout: Obtain the Qingyun Token First
choices.description: Han Lie is simple-minded but possesses monstrous combat power. Confronting him directly is unwise. However, his weakness is face—his defeat by your hand three years ago is his most unwelcome humiliation. Using this as leverage may secure cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Requires expending the relationship bargaining chip with Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie harbors deep grudges. Once negotiations collapse, the consequences would be dire.

text.content: "That fool Han Lie despises anyone mentioning past events, yet that was precisely his most devastating defeat." Chen Ji calculated in his heart, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "If this matter were to spread, he would lose all face; if I use this as blackmail... let's see how long this so-called Xuanwu genius can hold out."

dialogue.content: "Han Lie, Han Lie, did you think what happened back then was simply over?" Chen Ji murmured softly, his tone carrying a playful edge. "That sword you lost to me is still carved into the stone wall at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate."

choices.text: Leverage Strategy: Contact Ye Qing First
choices.description: Demonic Saintess Ye Qing once held a secret agreement with Chen Ji. She is the only person who knows part of the Tianji Record's secrets. More importantly, her Demonic Path miasma can conceal the Tianji Record's aura—this is crucial for infiltrating Tianji Palace.
choices.visible_cost: Requires revealing more trump cards to gain trust
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Youming Bead and infiltration cover
choices.risk_hint: Though Ye Qing is already allied, those of the Demonic Path are inherently unpredictable and cannot be fully trusted.

text.content: "Ye Qing should still have the contact seal from back then." Chen Ji drew a black jade talisman from his embrace, etched with an eerie manjusaka flower. "When I made that secret pact with her, I left this escape route. Those of the Demonic Path value profit over principle, but as long as the stakes are high enough, she will stand with me."

dialogue.content: "Saintess Ye Qing, it's been a while." Chen Ji infused spiritual energy into the jade talisman. Those eerie patterns immediately flickered with a ghostly green glow. "I have a business proposition here—wonder if you're bold enough to take it?"

choices.text: Direct Approach: Question Mo Xiansheng First
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the remnant soul guardian left by Chen Xuan. He knows the complete truth of the Tianji Record. Before making decisions, perhaps more information about Tianji Palace should be extracted from him—after all, know yourself and your enemy, and you can fight a hundred battles without defeat.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger Mo Xiansheng's hidden restrictions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence on Tianji Palace
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng only reveals "what should be said." Asking too many questions may achieve the opposite effect.

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng," Chen Ji turned to the remnant soul, wearing perfectly measured respect on his face. "There is something this junior does not understand. Since Tianji Palace is the core of the Heavenly Eye, why does it require tokens from both the Righteous and Demonic Paths to enter?"

dialogue.content: "A good question." Mo Xiansheng's laughter echoed in Chen Ji's mind. "The existence of Tianji Palace was meant to balance the two Paths. A thousand years ago, the Righteous and Demonic Paths jointly sealed the Heavenly Eye once. Those two tokens were the keys left from that封印..."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons, his fingers accidentally brushed against something in his embrace. There lay a yellowed paper contract—a secret agreement he had made with a mysterious person three years ago. Back then he had thought it merely an idle move; now he suddenly realized the seal on it seemed somehow connected to Tianji Palace.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Chen Ji retrieved that paper contract and examined it carefully. The ink from three years ago had long dried, yet the符文 on it glowed faintly—that was an隐匿阵法 only revealing itself when exposed to specific energies. "It seems that senior from back then had already foreseen today's events." He murmured, the curve of his lips growing deeper. "The board-setter, move upon move. I thought I was the Chess Player, yet I too am merely a piece on the board."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul stared at that paper contract in silence for a long while. "This agreement..." His voice suddenly turned strange. "It is no ordinary contract. It is the token jointly signed by the Righteous and Demonic Paths when Tianji Palace was sealed—in other words, it itself is a key." The remnant's shadow trembled violently. "Boy, from the very beginning you possessed the qualification to enter Tianji Palace. You simply didn't know it!"

Chen Ji's hand holding that paper contract paused slightly. He lowered his gaze to this seemingly ordinary deed, then burst into laughter. "What masterful premeditation, what interlocking precision." His laughter echoed through the night air, carrying both exhilaration and self-mockery. "It seems that senior is more of a Chess Player than I am. Since that is the case—" He tucked the paper contract into his embrace and cast his gaze toward the churning dark clouds above the Nine Heavens. "Let this game grow even more interesting."

The night wind brushed past, stirring Chen Nian's hair. She gazed up at her brother's profile, unable to fully grasp what the adults were discussing, yet she could sense the impending tension in the air. She gently squeezed Chen Ji's hand and softly said: "Brother, whatever you decide to do, I am here." Chen Ji lowered his gaze to her, to those clear yet resolute eyes, and felt a soft corner of his heart lightly stirred. "Mm." He replied, then turned to face the distant horizon. "Let's go meet an old friend."

As Chen Ji drew out the yellowed secret agreement from his embrace, the gaze of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly became profound—that document, which should have been a mere bargaining chip casually obtained three years ago, had now become the sole key to reaching his father.
